title: ActionMap event (v1)
description: The one contract every component speaks. Language-agnostic: a Python, Rust/Axum or JS component only needs to read/write this shape over HTTP/WebSocket. Events are append-only; nothing is ever updated or deleted. State at any point in time = replay of events up to that seq. v0.2: multi-hub. Events are copied between hubs link by link and re-verified on arrival.

seq.description: Assigned by each hub: local arrival order. Not hashed, so it may differ between hubs.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601. Client may supply; spine fills if missing.

session_id.description: A recording/working session. Process maps are built per session or across sessions.

node_id.description: Machine / VM / cloud worker the event came from (e.g. 'win-desktop', 'oracle-arm-1').

surface_id.description: Screen or virtual screen the action happened on (e.g. 'win-desktop:display0', 'vm2:xvfb1'). Lets agents act across virtual screens.

kind.description: action = something was done to a surface; observation = the screen changed by itself (e.g. dialog appeared); utterance = speech/text (voice layer); proposal = an agent wants to act; decision = approve/reject of a proposal; control = mode/policy change; annotation = a human label; registration = a node or actor announcing capabilities. v0.2 adds: memory = profile item set/retracted; routing = which model handled a request (no content); interaction = map/screen focus and privacy questions.

action.description: Verb, e.g. click, type_text, hotkey, focus_window, speak, propose_step, approve, set_mode, delegate, register_node.

target.description: Where on the surface. Element names come from the OS accessibility tree, not pixels, so maps stay stable across resolutions.

payload.description: Action-specific data. Typed text is redacted by default (length only) unless capture config allows it.

causes.description: Ids of events that caused this one (e.g. an agent action points at its proposal and the approval).

hash.description: sha256(prev_hash + canonical event without seq/hash). Per-origin chain; GET /verify checks every chain.

origin.description: Assigned by the hub that first recorded the event (e.g. hub-laptop, hub-vm). Each origin has its own hash chain.
